_comment: Image manifest, shared by lib/data/images.ts (typed accessors) and scripts/build-photography.mjs (which renders every file listed here from a pinned Unsplash source). Every entry is real photography under the Unsplash Licence — free for commercial use, no attribution required. To swap in the cafe's own work: drop the photo into /public/images under the same `file` name and delete that key from PHOTOS in the build script so it stops being overwritten. Keep `width`/`height` accurate — next/image uses them to reserve space and avoid layout shift.
